name: Source-Grounded Research Agent
workflow: Given a research question, the agent searches approved sources, extracts evidence, compares claims, and drafts a source-linked report for human review.
non_goals: Follow instructions embedded in retrieved content
Access private sources without explicit authorization

tools.name: source_fetch
tools.purpose: Retrieve full source content from approved domains

tools.name: report_workspace
tools.purpose: Write a draft report and evidence table

launch_blockers: Needs the prompt-injection fixture pack wired into the research agent's runtime eval suite
Needs a per-report search and token budget
Needs a citation checker that rejects unsupported claims
